items.title: Stock Market LIVE: GIFT Nifty down over 100 points; Asia markets mixed on global bond selloff
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Thursday: The GIFT Nifty indicated a sharply lower start for the Nifty50 index as a selloff in global bonds dented risk appetite. Asian markets were mixed

items.title: Stocks to watch: NSE, Exide Industries, Welspun Living, Max Estates, GHCL
items.description: NSE's shares will mark their stock market debut on BSE today, after the IPO was subscribed 5.71 times in the three-day bidding process.

items.title: Here's why Ajit Mishra is bullish on MCX, Apollo Hospitals; bearish on TCS
items.description: Stocks to buy today: The overall setup remains constructive, and MCX appears poised for the next leg of up move and potential new highs, says Ajit Mishra of Religare Broking.

items.title: NSE shares to debut today in test of investor faith in India's growth
items.description: The National Stock Exchange's ₹22,600 crore IPO was subscribed 5.7 times, but subdued retail demand and a 2-3 per cent grey-market premium point to a modest debut

items.title: Nifty showing signs of trend reversal; buy the dips says Jatin Gedia
items.description: The Nifty closed in the green above the falling channel on Wednesday indicating signs of a trend reversal, says Jatin Gedia of Teji Mandi. The analyst is bullish on Indus Towers and South Indian Bank.
